member.name: T:CausalExplorer.Application.EventNodes.Queries.SearchEventNodesQueryHandler
member.summary:
Handles with a three-phase strategy:
Keyword search in Neo4j.
Semantic vector search via Qdrant (fallback when keyword returns nothing).
On-demand knowledge-graph generation via Wikipedia + LLM (fallback when semantic scores are all below VectorSearch:RelevanceThreshold, default 0.70). Generated nodes are immediately persisted to Neo4j and Qdrant so future queries are served from the database.
Initialises the handler.
